title: Architect – Healthcare / Hospital Projects
description:
We are looking for a qualified and experienced **Architect** with strong expertise in **Healthcare and Hospital Project Design** to join our team.

Key Requirements

* Valid registration with the **Council of Architecture (COA)** as per the Architects Act, 1972.
* Minimum **B.Arch or M.Arch degree** from an accredited institution.
* Minimum **3 years of experience in Healthcare / Hospital Project Design**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp**, and other relevant architectural design software.
* Strong knowledge of **building materials, construction methods, and regulatory requirements**.
* Excellent **creativity, visualization, design, and problem-solving skills**.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to effectively coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop architectural concepts and designs for **hospitals and healthcare facilities**.
* Prepare architectural drawings, design presentations, and project concepts.
* Prepare **working drawings, detailed layouts, 3D models, and comprehensive design documentation**.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.
* Ensure designs comply with **building codes, safety regulations, healthcare standards, and statutory requirements**.
* Conduct regular **site visits** and resolve design-related issues during the project execution phase.
* Coordinate architectural design with structural, MEP, and other project requirements.
* Support the project team throughout the design and execution stages.

Preferred Skills

**AutoCAD | Revit | SketchUp | 3D Visualization | Hospital Planning | Healthcare Architecture | Working Drawings | Site Coordination | Building Codes | Project Coordination**

Experience

**3+ Years in Healthcare / Hospital Architecture**

Education

**B.Arch / M.Arch**

Registration

**Council of Architecture (COA) Registration Mandatory**

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹90,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
